items.note: The prompt opens with "a B2B note-taking app that is adding team workspaces."
It says "The readers are engineering and design leads" and frames the doc as being for a kickoff.
The In list covers creating a workspace, inviting members by email, and shared notes inside a workspace.
It says "Roles: admin and member only."
The out-of-scope list is billing changes, SSO, and guest access.
It gives the metric exactly as the user did and says to use that wording as given. Any other metric must be labelled "Proposed".
